title: T40 transient same-origin cross-tab coordination only
x-runtime-constraints: authority_scope is an in-memory hash of the currently reverified principal and effective authorization revision, without token/CSRF
BroadcastChannel is a bounded dedup hint, never authorization or a business event source; foreign/stale scope and malformed messages are ignored
only the current same-origin exclusive Web Lock leader may start automatic sound/desktop notification
leader acquisition, identity/authorization change, reload, hidden/online recovery and transport gap establish a fresh baseline before future live eligibility; they do not play older retained events
unsupported or rejected coordination keeps visual notices and manual test available but disables automatic sound/desktop notifications
